findings.evidence: check_bindings uses artifact_bindings.step_id; eligibility uses trusted_routes[record_id].step_id without equality check. Step canonical_record_id is not checked.
findings.issue: Validated step and evaluated step can differ
findings.required_fix: Require route.step_id == bound step_id, bound route_id==record_id, step.canonical_record_id==record_id and dependency.step_id==step.step_id. Reject mismatched route/step before eligibility.

findings.evidence: checker_report bytes hash is verified, but checker_report_locator key is unused and per-case verdict/approved scopes/blocked scopes/final artifact attestation are not parsed.
findings.issue: Independent checker verdict and exact final artifact approval are not consumed
findings.required_fix: Resolve checker case using exact locator, require exactrecord ID and finalcase/step/rule/source/package hashes and allowedscopes. Approved scopes may not exceed checker-supported scopes; retained blocks take precedence.

findings.evidence: Policy/source-limit routes source_support_ids are not required in bound source_sha256s. Eligibility rules source_evidence_ids/policy_source_ids/clarification_evidence_ids are not required in sourcebindings.
findings.issue: Source closure omissions for non-step routes and rules
findings.required_fix: Require every route and rule referenced source to be hashbound, correct manual whereOEM, and approved for this use. No broad policyroute can evade its own source references.

findings.evidence: eligibility iterates applicability_rule_ids only, leaving safety_rule_ids and repeat_rule_ids unevaluated.
findings.issue: Safety and repeat bindings are verified but not evaluated
findings.required_fix: Either explicitly restrict returned eligibility to initial applicability-only with safety/repeat notestablished, or evaluate exact reviewed safety precedence and repeat rules. Cannot label a release step eligible when these required gates remain unchecked.

findings.evidence: Claim refs checked, but unresolved_evidence_ids, parentprocedure sources, next_step_evidence_ids and claim source_spans offsets/text_sha256 are not checked against exact objects.
findings.issue: Additional step sources and source span integrity are omitted
findings.required_fix: For approvedscope include all applicable unresolved/procedure/next sources and hashbound objects. Validate 0<=start<=end<=len(exact_text), source.text_sha256 == SHA(exact_text), and each span text hash. Reject excluded adaptive scope instead of claiming it wasverified.

findings.evidence: self.artifacts[Path(name).name] permits multiple approvedpaths with same basename; final one wins.
findings.issue: Artifact basename collision can override approved object selection
findings.required_fix: Reject duplicate artifact basenames or select explicit unique manifest role paths.

findings.evidence: Exactly161 unique manifest records is checked, but equality with pinned plannerinventory and route/fixture IDsets is not.
findings.issue: Count-only coverage does not establish the intended161 IDs
findings.required_fix: Require all intended161 recordIDs equal approvedmanifest, finalroutes, finalfixtures and pinnedplanner inventory; reject substituted/dropped IDs.

recommendation: Fix exactbinding and scopedgate omissions before announcing verified eligibility. User-delegated coordinator authority is valid; no human_signoff requirement should be reintroduced.
